settings.minimum_bid_basis: Working assumption; lowest recorded auction purchase is $1. Formal rule not confirmed.

keeper_evidence.basis: Same-player keeper decisions are secondary upward evidence. Scope/cap selected on development auctions; repeated same-contract decisions and overlap with an auction comp are discounted. Contributions saturate below the 40% ceiling. Current claims use each claimant's own calculated cost; 50% claim reliability is an uncalibrated working assumption because earlier unsuccessful-claim logs are unknown. See keeper-influence-check.json.

comp_profile_adjustment.basis: Retain the full fitted elite curve in the regression base; translate qualified auction bids using category and age effects without the squared-score difference. Selected by development auction MAE from fixed curve strengths after a rejected uniform-shrinkage audit. Symmetric for better/worse profiles, no name or price floor. See output/valuations/profile-adjustment-check.json; later seasons are reused retrospective checks.

settings.market_age_basis: Recorded historical season age advanced to the auction season. Missing ages use the corresponding statistics-only model; no age is guessed. Age is a pricing feature, not a predetermined youth or keeper premium.

survivor.season_length_basis: NBA calendar October 20, 2026 through April 11, 2027 inclusive; assumes the league uses the full regular season.
survivor.schedule_basis: Illustrative elimination schedules, not confirmed dates or probabilities. Thirteen cuts leave two teams; a two-week cadence throughout would exceed this season's length.
survivor.availability_basis: Published games spread uniformly through the season; dated injuries, NBA game schedules and lineup limits are not available.
survivor.replacement_basis: Balanced neutral rosters: after each cut, replacement depth follows remaining teams times 15 roster slots. Category scores stay on the original scale. Final two teams imply a top-30 pool; this is a scenario, not guaranteed waiver access.
survivor.moves_basis: Neutral pool turnover costs 15 / teams_before_cut expected acquisitions per surviving team. Stop improving replacement depth when the 100-move allowance is exhausted. Actual waivers, sniper picks and move usage are not simulated.
survivor.scoring_basis: Cumulative contribution conditional on reaching the final; no assumed elimination probability or statistics reset.

settings.horizon: Per-game category advantage integrated above rising replacement levels, using published availability and a shared 1,000-game pacing limit.
settings.market_basis: Use archived preseason forecasts for 2017-18 through 2025-26, with preceding actuals as explicit proxies only for 2015-16 and 2016-17. Missing or invalid archive rows and documented preseason availability exceptions are excluded. Unknown games and age stay unknown. Comparables must meet category, production, age and known-games limits; both stat lines use the target reference scale. Strong forecast matches carry at least 80% of comp weight when present. No qualifying comps means the regression estimate alone. Exact league auction dates and the 2025-26 workbook provider/date are unverified.
settings.comp_influence_basis: Near-identical forecasts get at least 95% of comp weight and a 90% final comp blend (at least 85.5% effective influence). Require known age and projected GP, strict stat/age/GP gaps, an auction within three seasons, and distance no more than 65% of the nearest alternative. These weights implement the requested dominance, not a statistically calibrated gain: only one retrospective auction qualifies and none in development. Without this tier, retain v7: close 80% minimum weight / 75% blend, supporting-only 25% blend. See output/valuations/near-identical-check.json and the rejected broad-rule audit.

league_rules.category_status: Standard eight categories inferred from eight-category roto without turnovers; confirm exact categories.
league_rules.season_mapping_status: Inferred from 11 consecutive league years and matching 2015-16 through 2025-26 tracking tabs.
league_rules.roster_size_status: Observed in 163 of 165 team-seasons; lineup and bench rules unconfirmed.
league_rules.budget_status: Confirmed by the supplied 2026 keeper summary: keeper costs plus remaining budget equal $200 for all 15 teams.
league_rules.target_season_status: 2026 keeper summary supplied for the upcoming 2026-27 season.
league_rules.elimination_schedule: First elimination a month and a bit into the season; then every one or two weeks until two teams remain. Exact dates not supplied.
league_rules.eliminated_player_acquisition_rule: Eliminated rosters enter regular waivers. Unclaimed players enter a sniper draft in reverse original waiver order.
league_rules.waiver_order_rule: Order selected before the season. No team repeats an earlier year's position within the 15-year cycle; reset in year 16. Actual orders not supplied.
league_rules.historical_manager_identity: Sheet names identify franchise histories, not necessarily the manager in older seasons. Tracking headers are preserved separately.

validation.model_selection_basis: Candidate choice uses development-year MAE only. Later seasons have been reviewed during earlier model development and are reused retrospective checks, not fresh independent holdouts.
validation.interpretation: Seasons with archived forecasts use their preseason stat profiles; other seasons use prior-year actuals as explicit proxies. Published per-game-only archives have unknown projected GP. The 2025-26 user workbook has unverified provider/date. Missing or invalid forecasts and documented availability exceptions are excluded, changing the evaluation cohort. Exact league auction dates are unknown. Current estimates are not independently validated.

keeper_evidence.claim_coverage: Only explicitly recorded claims; older unsuccessful-claim logs are unknown. Current claim weight is not calibrated by the earlier auction checks.
keeper_evidence.basis: Auction-only regression; secondary same-player keeper evidence. Same-season decisions precede auctions, with no future-season records or realized auction-season statistics.

settings.basis: Same-player keeper decisions are secondary upward evidence. Scope/cap selected on development auctions; repeated same-contract decisions and overlap with an auction comp are discounted. Contributions saturate below the 40% ceiling. Current claims use each claimant's own calculated cost; 50% claim reliability is an uncalibrated working assumption because earlier unsuccessful-claim logs are unknown. See keeper-influence-check.json.

preseason_evidence.coverage: Documented exceptions, not a complete injury or role-change archive. Unlisted players have unreviewed preseason availability, not certified health.
preseason_evidence.date_basis: Dated preseason reports. Exact league auction dates were not recorded, so these are preseason evidence checks, not verified auction-day snapshots.

retention_audit.interpretation: Only finalists, classified by preceding-season per-game rank. Matching opening and final snapshots does not prove continuous ownership. This descriptive audit is not used to fit replacement dates or prices.

validation.neutral_value_basis: Equal category weights; linear allocation of positive survivor value above replacement. No historical price fitting, star multiplier or category punt. Scenario estimate, not an empirically validated optimum.
validation.market_price_basis: Conditional on selection at auction; keeper-adjusted discretionary money per available talent unit. Individual estimates are not a simultaneous auction allocation. Team budget distribution is displayed, not a simulation of manager bidding.

interval.basis: Absolute normalized out-of-season price errors, grouped by predicted price tier; descriptive error band, not a guaranteed confidence interval.
